visualCharacteristics: One white panel with a 2-column list of people: round portrait left, condensed name, optional small role line and bio right; continuous divider lines between rows; single column on mobile

cells: H3 name link; optional role paragraph; bio paragraph (show names in italics)
contentPattern.structure: two cells: a square portrait, then an H3 name link, an optional role paragraph and a bio paragraph. With two or more paragraphs after the name, the first is the role

usage.description: 'Meet Our Chefs & Hosts' on the homepage (8 chef/host profiles).

reuseGuidance: Use for lists of people with a portrait, linked name and short bio. Author an even number of rows for a full 2-column panel. Put a section heading and any 'See all' link as default content before the block.
